2121535476905476537.en_summary: ULA Vulcan’s launch is extremely important for $ASTS. Without Vulcan, almost entirely dependent on Blue Origin unless DPAS used to compel SpaceX. If ULA delivers 3 launches in Q4 (target), that's a 12/yr run-rate and possible cadence for 2027. ASTS securing even 4 of those would mean 20 BlueBirds a year. Already 12 up, 3 going up with SpaceX imminently, 1 Blue Origin launch in Q1 with 3 sats and 2 DPAS launches with SpaceX in Q1, taking to 24. ULA success gives a fairly clear path to c.44.
2121535476905476537.zh_summary: ULA Vulcan 的發射對 $ASTS 極為重要。沒有 Vulcan，幾乎完全依賴 Blue Origin，除非使用 DPAS 強制 SpaceX。若 ULA 在第四季交付 3 次發射（目標），即為每年 12 次的運行速率，並可能成為 2027 年的節奏。ASTS 若能獲得其中 4 次，將意味著每年 20 顆 BlueBirds。目前已有 12 顆在軌，即將透過 SpaceX 發射 3 顆，第一季有 1 次 Blue Origin 發射（3 顆衛星）及 2 次 DPAS 透過 SpaceX 發射，合計達 24 顆。ULA 的成功提供一條相當清晰的路徑至約 44 顆。

2121531120571281772.en_summary: $NDX Both the 1997 Nasdaq pullback and the current one happened during high optimism around a major technology wave (internet/tech infrastructure late ’90s, AI infrastructure today). 1997 saw ~12% correction (single-day ~7% drop on Oct 27) triggered by Asian financial crisis, short-lived, recovered in months, bull market continued. Current (mid-Nov 2026) similar size, Nasdaq Composite peaked near 27,600 on Oct 6, fell ~12% by early Nov, +6% single-day drop last week; trigger internal questions on AI data center/GPU spending returns and high valuations. Corrections common during rapid tech change. Believes still in late 1990s, big bubble still coming. 2026 Nasdaq 100 forward PE around 19-23 vs 1997 around 24-26; extreme valuations (multiples >40-50) came in 1999-2000.
2121531120571281772.zh_summary: $NDX 1997 年納斯達克回調與當前回調均發生在對重大技術浪潮高度樂觀時期（90 年代末網際網路／技術基礎設施，今日 AI 基礎設施）。1997 年因亞洲金融危機經歷約 12% 修正（10 月 27 日單日約 7% 下跌），較短暫，數月內恢復，牛市持續。當前（2026 年 11 月中）規模類似，納斯達克綜合指數於 10 月 6 日見頂近 27,600，至 11 月初下跌約 12%，上週有單日 +6% 下跌；觸發因素為對 AI 數據中心／GPU 支出回報的質疑及高估值。快速技術變革期間此類修正較常見。認為仍處於 90 年代末，大泡沫尚未到來。2026 年納斯達克 100 遠期本益比約 19-23，對比 1997 年約 24-26；真正極端估值（倍數遠超 40-50）出現在 1999-2000 年。

2121529643580682277.en_summary: Many down significantly this year, especially if heavily in AI sector hit over past month. Portfolio always volatile, not interested in S&P 500 or ETFs. Now with six-figure portfolio, large swings (up/down six figures) make rethink management. Still long-term investor, not panicking, hold long-term if believe in business, cut short-term losses quickly. Changes: won't go all-in on one stock; take more profits and keep cash; look at other sectors, diversify a little from AI as negative headlines trigger sector sell-offs. Manage risks better with larger amounts. NFA.
2121529643580682277.zh_summary: 許多人本年大幅虧損，尤其若重倉 AI 板塊過去一個月受挫。投資組合一直波動，對標普 500 或 ETF 不感興趣。現時六位數投資組合，大幅波動（上下六位數）促使重新思考管理。仍為長線投資者，不恐慌，若相信業務則持有長線，短線通常快速止損。改變：不會全押一隻股票；多取利潤並保留現金；關注其他板塊，從 AI 稍作分散，因負面頭條可觸發板塊拋售。因金額更大需更好管理風險。非投資建議。
